Biography

The Past

Princess Mireille, daughter of Queen Darkwater, was once a quiet, docile and refined girl with porcelain pallor, trying to please her mother in everything; Lady Sophia, who met her at the court, found her too submissive for Yanmei blood. She studied herbs, earth frogs, and poisonous leeches (Nan-Claire has thirty-three of them) and, as a witch, experienced twenty-six classic poisons before being given the right to prepare her own mixtures. According to her, it is difficult to be a cheerful person if you have tasted twenty-six deadly poisons since childhood.

Nine or ten years before the events of the cycle, she quarreled with Lady in Darkness and was expelled from the palace, capital and kingdom. (Lady in the Dark) She found shelter in the Voltaic Islands, from where, according to rumors, several times sent to the mother of the murderers. The reason for the quarrel at the court remained a mystery. At the court of Minerva, the Queen was considered “almost childless”: her only daughter became a citizen of the Volta. Mireille herself later explained that her mother hated her not for claiming the throne, but for refusing to inherit. At one time, she considered her mother to be the “key” to terrible trouble; those years, Mireille admitted, include an unreasonable conflict with her, rejection of heritage and “several rash cruel acts.”

Face

On the Folta, Mireille tanned to bronze, which in the south of Polaris would be considered obscene, and dropped the painful look. Underneath the subtlety of her features now lurked a flame; massive bracelets emphasized the brittle mobility of the wrists, a necklace - a thin nerve neck. She wore a wide-brimmed hat and smoked a long thin tube with strong foltic tobacco. On her necklace was a silver pendant in the form of a tree on a tiny island: Mireille ordered it from a Foltic jeweler as "a reminder of what should not be forgotten."

The “Yanmei Hunt”

In May 1775, Lady in Darkness and Francis-Ilian proposed to Erwin Origin a plan by which the throne would eventually go to him, and for the sake of legality, he would marry Mireille, whom his mother would allow to return. Erwin rejected the conspiracy. Suspecting Lady in the Darkness, he decided to send a reliable ambassador to Mirai to find out the reasons for her breakup with her mother. On 21 May, after the second hearing of Manson's trial, Erwin asked her mother if she was familiar with Lady Mireille, and contrary to her father's objections, he asked her to go to the Folta: kairs, he said, are "evil shirts with swords" and will not cause confidence in the princess, and here women's flexibility is needed. "Okay, Erwin. I'll talk to Lady Mireille," said Lady Sophia. (Sophia Jessica Augusta)

In "Humans and Gods"

Meeting

In mid-June 1775, at the port of Maple on the shore of the Far Sea, before arriving on the Volta, Lady Sophia met Mireille: in response to the flag signal "Lady Origin invites Admiral Volta to visit" she sailed on a boat and boarded the schooner "Sea Arrow" along with the Voltaic captains Doris Lykan and Shiron Kolid. (Likein and Colistad) The princess invited the Duchess to hunt a gurken - the greatest of the sea monsters, which the Foltians caught only three times, and the Polarians never. The Northern sailors and kairs dissuaded the Duchess, suspecting a trap, but Sofia decided that a joint hunt would help to get closer to Mireille and find out the reason for her quarrel with her mother. She agreed, and four ships, including the Guardian, the White Wolf and the Sea Arrow, left the port of Maple and went far east.

Swimming

For a week of conversations, Mireille became Sofia’s closest person after her husband and children. She managed her favorite trick: to go into the shadows, forcing the interlocutor to speak - she did not ask questions, but said something that Sofia could not help answering. Mireille told the sailors about the "black badger", an invisible predator: the sailor the Descendant checked her words, and before his eyes the black spot dissolved the rat thrown overboard. She talked about Darkwater's witch fights.

When Sophia directly asked if she was going to marry Erwin, Mireille replied that she had made a vow of celibacy in the Foltia temple before fulfilling her goal. She compared the world to a locked door, behind which lurks something terrible:

“Imagine my fright when I found out the key had already been inserted into the lock.”

This key is the primrose, and her mother is only an "inept servant" trying to turn the key. The shooting of the heretics of the Rings, she says, is only "a chaff of that tree of horror" of which she speaks; to use the Objects for shooting is like pricking nuts with a gold bullion. Mireille believed that only Erwin could help, and when asked if she wanted him to prevent her mother from entering into an alliance with Paul, she replied: "So you can say. On this spiral of understanding."

Eastern Label

The expedition reached the island of East Mark, where travelers found an old wreck and a map of Polaris carved on a rock marked "Water of Death". Mireille explained that there are six such Metok Islands and they ring the continent at a distance: to the east and south lies a strip of safe waters of five hundred miles, to the west it is narrow.

“Our continent, my lady, is an island of order.”

When the judge puzzled about the girl who refused the forbidden room, tears came out in front of Mereya. In the letter, Sophia warned her son not to trust Queen Madeline and the entire order.

The Shadow of the Great Tree

Swimming to the Marks and the way to the First Winter

At the end of July, the Sea Arrow visited the North-Eastern Mark, where Sophia comprehended the mystery of the Great Tree; Mireille and the judge vowed to reveal it if the Duchess died. According to Mireille, there were six Metok Islands, and Sofia decided to visit at least three of them, and then return to the First Winter by Descent Day through the port of Windley. The squadron passed along the boundary of the disastrous waters, fleeing from the mirage and crawling “skeletons” of the South-Eastern Mark. A couple of days later, the Voltians tracked down the young gurken; after many hours of fighting, the Guardian, the White Wolf and the Sea Arrow killed him and cut off three tentacles - one on the ship - but immediately fell into a terrible storm and were carried far into the deadly waters. When in the sticky water, from where the combustible poisonous bubbles rose, the explosion boldly people from the deck of the "Guard", the squadron was banned from fire, and the phone was taken from Mireille. On the way back, the squadron made parking at the cannibals of the Thousand Shards archipelago, who, seeing the dried tentacle of the gurken, fell prostrate in front of the monsters' winners. While still swimming, Sophia wrote to her son that she had achieved “friendship and harmony with Lady Mireille” and extended the mission until December. Through the South Label and the Thousand Shards archipelago, where Mireille, along with Sophia and Margaret's maid, drew lots to portray Mother Mother Mother before the cannibals, the squadron arrived at the port of Windley in early November. There Mireille, together with Sophia, the judge and the kairs, went ashore and learned the news of the blockade of the First Winter and the capture of Iona. Bypassing the troops of Adrian, the travelers went along the mountain path through the Beyond - along the fjords, through the Hem of the Servants, the path of the White Wanderers and the grotto of Kosuli; two grays died, and Mireille fell from fatigue, and she had to carry. (Roe Deer Grotto) The detachment was late for the day: on the slope of the summit of Agatha, he found himself on December 3, 1775, the day after the battle, and, having spent the night at the monastery at the grotto of Kosuli, arrived at the castle of the First Winter. (Battle for First Winter)

The Mystery of the First Tree

Sofia, having learned about the death of her husband, could not speak herself, and the secret of the First Tree Erwin, Iona and Minerva instead told Mireille: "My duty is to tell what your mother was going to tell." Using the album of sketches of Sofia, she said that in the time of Pramatery Polaris was inhabited by deadly monsters, and people lived “like worms”, hiding in burrows. Only the first tree grown by the Forefathers with three roots planted in large fresh water bodies, including the Bottomless Abyss and in the lake of the First Winter, made the continent livable; the first year of its dusty crown plunged the earth into an almost continuous night. Mireille feared that such knowledge would seem heresy: it turned out that Polaris was not created for people.

The purpose of the secret order is the Second Tree, which "will make gods of men"; for this order, the Absolute is needed as a transport to the Star, the bearer of the firstblood and Nathaniel. The mother dedicated Mireille to the order until the third stage, but the princess opposed it; the fourth stage remained unknown to her. She warned that after the defeat of the Puppeteer, the Lady-in-the-Dark would seek the help of the Origins, and asked not to give the order to either the Absolute or Nathaniel and not to help him with the carriers of the firstblood. Erwin, Iona and Minerva declared themselves opponents of the new Tree, and the Origins took under the protection of Nathaniel and Mireille herself. “I think we will need mutual protection,” the princess replied and handed Erwin a second album.

Negotiations

This second album contained a list of Darkwater's "arrows" - potions, poisons, predatory insects and worms, as well as rings, earrings, nails and powders for their delivery. Hyder Leed and Kair Aubrey studied it and instructed the guards, and Iona, watching the album the day before, recognized the deadly things on the ambassadors during negotiations with Adrian's delegation. Mireille herself, like Nathaniel, did not sit down at the common table to avoid a fight with her mother. That same night, Robert Origin killed Lady in the Dark.

In "Fantasies"

The author calls "Fantasies" fantasies about how the fates of heroes can develop. In them, Mireille becomes the queen of Darkwater.

"Amicably"

In August 1776, thirty-eight-year-old Mireille, who had spent ten years in exile, arrives in Laam along with the northern expedition: Hyder Leed is ordered by Erwin to escort her to Darkwater and ensure her safety, and Jemis Lilliday goes to meet the bride, the infant Demeter. (Laem) At court, she is called the “aunt of the lady”. Lady Catherine Catherine read her political signs: Mireille sailed on the Foltic ships, "killers of monsters", and the pendant with a mystical tree was replaced by a pendant with a white gull - the coat of arms of Stagforth, the ancestral domain of Minerva; therefore, behind Mireille are Folta, Minerva and Origin. (Minerva) Her rival is the nephew of the late Queen Emmon Darklin, who uses a lot of weight from the swamp nobility, but, according to Catherine, is cowardly. For the Shimmerian regiment, Mireille offered Prince Hector a secret fairway through the Tops of the Dark Kings, pilots to pass through which cost a quarter of the profits from each flight, and promised to become an ally of Shimmery "and Origin". (Hector of Shimmery) The ambassador of Darkwater, on behalf of Emmon, on the contrary, asked to be shackled in exchange for Darkwater's votes for Francis-Ilian in the election of the emperor.

Catherine's servants secretly searched her luggage; from the smells, Mireille realized that three things were touching, including hidden Assassin. She kept combat drugs on her body, and only protective equipment in the bag, but forgot to remove the bottle of landy - a love potion. It was carried for Jemis to help him with Demeter: Darkwater's witches have the spell considered a common part of courtship, and the turnip potion is sold at any Nan Clair healer's shop. Realizing that the court will decide that the witch is encroaching on the prince's heart, Mireille, along with Leed, came up with a way out ("I had one idea" - "I have, too!"). Soon, the harsh Hyder in front of Catherine rushed to Mireille and burned her hand with a kiss, and she announced that she also loved him; Mireille swore that the potion itself did not give: "another man took it." Lovers read poems, wandered around the garden until dawn and threatened that for love, Mireille would renounce the crown. Hector, convinced that the witch was outsmarted by her own potion, demanded that the “mad” drink the reverse. Even at this moment, "through the love spell fool", Mireille thought about the interrupted stage Jemis: "Eh, not in time, Count. We almost succeeded...” The lovers drank a turntable, and Hector returned the kidnapped nephew Barney to Hyder as a reward and gave Mireille a regiment of the Burning Sun. With his help, she took the throne of Darkwater, "although, quite possibly, would have coped without him." Left alone, Hyder and Mireille laughed, “It’s so damn nice to be back in youth!” “We can repeat it.” In subsequent years, the queen and kair more than once with tender nostalgia remembered this adventure.

"Ad-ri-an!"

In the autumn of 1776, on the days of the election of the emperor, Hyder Leed reported to Erwin in Faunterra that "Lady Mireille Nan-Claire is seated on the throne"; while he assured that he had only "slightly helped the queen in a peaceful way, and most importantly she did it herself", and rose when Erwin praised her. Together with Leed came the master of the school of Asphena, who called Mireille the most capable of her students, and the masteress of Kribola, whom Mireille defeated in a duel and spared. The Queen did not destroy her main rival Emmon Darklin, but made Darkwater a representative in the House, at the same time removing him from the country. The Queen asked the witch Kribola to vote for Erwin. Later, Erwin explained to Minerva that Mireille as "the purest Yanmei" would vote for her under equal conditions: therefore, Sofia whispered to her about her son's delight before the swamp culture for six months, the death of Lady in Darkness turned out to be "the best gift" for her daughter, and the ixam, given to help Mireille, were ordered not to show aggression in order not to touch the clans of sorcerers - genuine.

"Deadly Evidence"

The story takes place in June 1777. Detective Mack says that after the death of Lady in the Dark, her agents removed the Second of the Five and warned the cohesive order: the new Queen of Darkwater "cannot tolerate all these orders" and will try to either destroy or subdue the agents. According to Mac, the man Mireille could persuade the jealous deacon to kill the messenger and so intercept the mail of the whole county; Mac himself admits that he can not blame the queen.

Personality

He knows how to go into the shade, forcing others to speak; perceptive, nervous, mocking, smoking a pipe; skillful in poisons and antidotes. Underneath the outer lightness hides the fear of the secret that he knows. For the sake of the goal, she is ready for intrigue and self-sacrifice: even a love adventure in Laeme turned out to be an accurate political calculation.

Appearances

  • "The Yanmei Hunt" is mentioned.
  • "Humans and Gods" - the heads of Sofia (swimming on the "Sea Arrow").
  • "The Shadow of the Great Tree" - a return to the First Winter, the secret of the First Tree.
  • "Fantasies" - "Amicable" (one of the main characters), "Ad-ri-an!" and "Deadly Evidence" (mentioned).
